senses.gloss: go-yūthī, cf. sva-sīmā-tṛṇagoyūthī-gocara-paryanta (EI 8-5); yuthī is the same as yūti (or pūti) used in the same context in many other records in the compound tṛṇa-yūti (or tṛṇa-pūti). Goyūthī-gocara may be ‘the enclosure for cattle and pasture ground’.
go-yūti, same as go-yuthī; cf. yūti.
